currentTaskDescription: Enhancement #12: Worker graceful draining on SIGTERM - In ArgusWorkerBackgroundService, override StopAsync to honour configurable drain timeout. Read ARGUS_WORKER_DRAIN_TIMEOUT env var (default 60s). On StopAsync: signal no new tasks, wait for in-flight tasks up to drain timeout. Support checkpoint writing before yielding to cancellation for resume support. Update deploy/compose.yaml workers with stop_grace_period: 90s. File: src/BuildingBlocks/Argus.BuildingBlocks.Workers/ArgusWorkerBackgroundService.cs
